answer: Identity escrow: each new seat deposits its operator's verified identity encrypted to five unrelated trustees, so seats may wander the market under pseudonyms. When a random jury upholds a clone complaint, the accused seats' badges turn umber and three of five trustees decrypt both escrows; matching operators forfeit all linked bonds and merge into one reward share. A thousand-seat farm sits as exposed as tracks on tundra: one upheld case unmasks them all.
